answer.sql:
WITH line_tot AS (
  SELECT inv_id, SUM(ext_prc - tax_amn) AS rev_before_tax
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv_lns
  GROUP BY inv_id
),
inv AS (
  SELECT inv_id, inv_dt
  FROM wwicryptic.sl.t_inv
  WHERE inv_dt >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND inv_dt < DATE '2016-01-01'
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) = 2014 THEN l.rev_before_tax END) AS rev_2014,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.inv_dt) = 2015 THEN l.rev_before_tax END) AS rev_2015
  FROM inv i
  JOIN line_tot l ON l.inv_id = i.inv_id
)
SELECT ROUND((rev_2015 - rev_2014) / NULLIF(rev_2014, 0) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM yearly
LIMIT 501
